text: This candidate received an overall score of 0.1641 for the Senior Full Stack Software Developer position. The strongest evidence of their qualifications includes experience with "REST API", "Git", "Docker", "AWS", and "JavaScript". Key gaps include missing requirements for nodejs, ruby, reactjs, sql, and ci/cd, as well as a lower total years of experience than requested. This application has been escalated for manual review despite the low fit and missing must-have skills.
